message: What do we know about Dilini so far?
reply: Dilini is 21, daughter of Nimal and Kumari. She was accepted to the Colombo Medical Faculty (this is established in Episode 1). In episode 2 she prepares to leave the village for medical school — here she’s packing anatomy textbooks into a cloth bag and will depart. She wears a saree and has dark hair. The production also shows she’s emotionally conflicted: in this scene she says she’s afraid, and Sahan (her friend) does not want her to go.
